scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

protocol.scope:
Static per-deployment calibration control on the identical frozen fitted models.
No new training, features, architectures or protected labels. This distinguishes
training improvements from an overly restrictive shared probability cutoff.
protocol.selection_rule: Same feasibility-first worst-window ranking as shared-threshold experiment; only static calibration scope differs.
protocol.protected_policy: No protected label access in this executable. Protected evaluation requires a separate locked run after original joint criteria pass on all declared development stress environments plus measured resources.
protocol.note: Introduced during development before outcome arrays were scored; it is an additional methodological control, not the original preregistration.
